messages:
elaine: Heads up — seeing a spike in mTLS handshake failures for several proxied services in ap-southeast-1 since ~07:05 UTC. Ops alert fired.
ops-bot: ALERT: 2300 TLS handshake errors in last 5m for service-proxy-apac (p95 latency up). Link: https://console/alerts/12345 :rotating_light:
elaine: Example from logs:
```
proxy: 2026-03-21T07:06:12Z tls: handshake error from 10.42.1.9: remote error: tls: handshake failure
kms-client: 2026-03-21T07:06:12Z Decrypt failed: AccessDenied
```
sam: Did we just push the RBAC scoping change to KMS keys this morning? I merged rbac/2026-03-21-tighten-kms yesterday.
jamal: Yep — I scoped the KMS key so only service accounts with role kms-decrypt-main can decrypt. I tested in staging, but not full APAC roll.
lina: Correlation shows failures originate from proxies running in the new node pool that were upgraded at 06:50. Node metadata service changed their pod SA annotation mapping.
elaine: So likely the SA->role mapping broke and proxies lost KMS decrypt perms, causing them to fail session resumption which leads to handshake failures.
sam: Immediate plan: revert the RBAC patch to restore previous key policy. @deploy-bot kick a rollback to rbac/2026-03-21-tighten-kms
deploy-bot: Rollback started for change rbac/2026-03-21-tighten-kms -> target: IAM policy. Rolling back in ap-southeast-1 first.
ops-bot: Canary rollback deployed to 3 nodes. Monitoring for handshake errors.
elaine: Can we also surface audit logs for KMS calls during the window? Need to confirm if calls were denied or if proxy mis-sent SA.
security-bot: Export query: `resource.type=\"kms_key\" AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt AND timestamp>\"2026-03-21T06:40:00Z\" AND (status.code=7 OR status.code=401)` — run against audit-logs-prod. I queued export to gs://redwood-audit/apac-mtls-20260321.
jamal: I've started the audit log pull. Early results: ~18k denied Decrypt calls from proxy cluster nodes in window 07:02–07:10. Most show principal `system:serviceaccount:proxy-ns:proxy-sa-832` but the IAM binding is missing for that SA.
sam: Good catch. The node pool upgrade changed SA annotations due to the admission webhook order — old mapping was `proxy-sa` -> `kms-decrypt-main`, new nodes didn't get the grant applied by our bootstrap job.
lina: Temporary mitigations:
- revert RBAC (in progress)
- add short-lived fallback: proxy will attempt local ephemeral key via cache if Decrypt fails (canary) — requires code toggle
- raise alert suppression for duplicate noisy alerts (reduce pager churn)
elaine: Jamal — after rollback, can you create a small runbook entry: \"apac: RBAC bootstrap ordering — how to ensure node bootstrap reapplies KMS bindings\" and tag ops on it?
jamal: On it. I'll also add a check to our cluster-provision pipeline to validate SA->IAM bindings post node rotation.
security-bot: Post-incident tasks recommended: KMS audit retention snapshot, verify least-privilege bindings, add automation to reapply bindings if missing, and add metric for `kms_decrypt_denied_count_by_sa`.
sam: Rollback complete in ap-southeast-1 at 07:22 UTC. Handshake errors dropped to baseline within two minutes. Rolling rollback to remaining regions is on hold until we confirm bootstrap fix.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: rbac/2026-03-21-tighten-kms reverted in ap-southeast-1.
lina: Can we get a short-term alert rule throttling for the next 24h to avoid alert storms while we stabilise? I'll update alerts to group by SA and suppress noise for repeated identical failures.
elaine: Also want a deeper postmortem assigned. Owners: jamal (remediation), lina (observability followup), sam (deploy pipeline fix). Please add timeline, root cause, impact numbers, and a proposed permanent fix (either bootstrap reordering or idempotent binding job + test).
jamal: I'll draft the postmortem and link audit snapshot. ETA EOD.
elaine: Thanks — once postmortem is up we'll schedule a 30-min review with infra and product security. For now, setting alert severity back to medium.
ops-bot: Incident resolved: handshake failure spike mitigated. Follow-ups in #eng-security-postmortems.
elaine: Reminder: check KMS key rotation window tomorrow — avoid scheduled rotations during node pool upgrades. :calendar:
sam: Agreed. I'll add a gating check in the rotation pipeline.
jamal: Added runbook draft to /docs/runbooks/apac-kms-bootstrap.md and linked the audit snapshot. Will ping when ready for review.
elaine: Great work team. Quick wins: rollback + audit export. Longer term: pipeline test and binding auto-heal. Closing thread once postmortem links are attached. :white_check_mark:
